name: raylinv
expr: x_s = raylinv(0.5, 1); x_v = raylinv(qs, 1); x_q0 = raylinv(0, 1); x_q1 = raylinv(1, 1); x_qneg = raylinv(-0.1, 1); x_qover = raylinv(1.5, 1); x_b0 = raylinv(0.5, 0); x_bneg = raylinv(0.5, -1);
comment: Sig: x = raylinv(p, b). Inverse Rayleigh CDF: x = b·sqrt(-2·ln(1-p)). q=0 → 0; q=1 → Inf; q outside [0,1] → NaN. b<=0 → NaN.
